name: Titanfall doubles Titanstrike's leech (#1679)
contract: Titanstrike rank 1 (806521) leeches health with an effect value multiplier of 1. Titanfall 300607 is a +100% SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER passive on the Titanstrike family mask, so the multiplier becomes 2 and the strike heals twice the damage dealt.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
